issues.description: The problem statement (task description) incorrectly tells students that dd_get_amplitude should return the probability as a float, while the template and solution implement dd_get_amplitude as returning the complex amplitude (np.complex128). This is a return-type / semantic mismatch that will confuse students about whether to return an amplitude (complex) or a probability (real).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to state that dd_get_amplitude should return the complex amplitude (np.complex128) for the given bitstring (consistent with the template function signature and the solution), or alternatively change the template/solution to return a probability (float) if the intended task is to compute measurement probabilities. Make the wording consistent across problem_statement.md, dd_simulation.py (template), and tests.
